label: business-output heartbeat
fail_hint: A scheduler may be running but producing no useful output. Check the named lanes in the Command Center.
_why: DD12 (third-party audit 2026-10-15): the off-box dead-man (config/offbox_deadman.json) proves the ALERT PATH is alive; it cannot see a running scheduler that produces nothing. This SECOND external check watches business output with its own ping URL, so a healthy alert path cannot keep it green. Activation (timer + provider check + secret) is operator-only: docs/ops/packets/n8n-dd12-outside-deadman-20261015/.
provider: the same healthchecks.io-class service as config/offbox_deadman.json, a separate check (its own UUID)
